title: Write herdr-runner.md substrate adapter
description: New file skills/ticks/references/herdr-runner.md mapping the runner-neutral contract (agent-runner.md) onto herdr primitives, referencing herdr-kinds.md and runners-config.md rather than duplicating them. Must cover: spawn (worktree create -> root_pane.pane_id -> agent start -> prompt --wait), the result contract (branch commits + RESULT.md + tk state only; terminal scraping forbidden and why - alternate screen), wave fan-in without the helper CLI (backgrounded agent wait per worker OR bounded polling of agent list, stated as interim until layer 2), blocked-state handling (escalate to human, never send-keys through approval UIs), integration/merge/post-wave gate exactly per agent-runner.md, crash reconcile (workers survive; .tick/ + herdr agent list + agent_session), and cleanup (worktree remove per workspace). Follow the structure/tone of the existing four adapters.
acceptance_criteria: herdr-runner.md reads as a drop-in fifth adapter; every capability in agent-runner.md's contract has a herdr mapping or an explicit gap note; no duplicated content from A1/A2 files
